A new exact bounded repair-and-validate grant composes existing repaired producer and resumed local evidence modules; persistent dispatch/completion markers, immutable old grants, original accounting continuity and read-only verification. No publication integration or live-effect qualification.

Repair hardening binds canonical original intake/run evidence and recognized intake implementation, preserves raw uncomposed plan gaps and pinned citation protocols, reparses original and repair proposals from completed paid responses, and enforces optional implementation operation ceilings before reservation.
Protect the entire original intake outer state from repair output overlap and preserve safe rejection of non-object API configurations.
Derive repaired-candidate assessment reuse from all original source evidence across the complete original baseline diff, and independently verify the reuse field before validation.

Project repair diagnostic resource candidates through the existing public-capability whitelist for provider disclosure, retaining the complete unresolved local plan and all source-backed uncertainties.

Opt-in review evidence policy preserves substantive Markdown criteria and source-bound unchanged credential-literal projections, enforces covered citations in the wire schema, and preserves legacy grants and rejected outcomes. Offline regression tested; live continuation requires a fresh exact grant.

Bound further explicitly authorized funding increases through pinned acyclic campaign ancestry, preserve all prior full allocations and replay identities, and enforce schema-2 per-continuation paid-generation limits including unknown attempts. Qualified by nine continuation and 31 legacy API offline contracts.

Allow a fresh explicit resumed validation grant to reuse only a fully reconstructed identical completed paid source/workspace review; retain old bytes and accounting, forward its provenance through execution acceptance and delivery, and bound the new grant to one generation. Separate 180-second staging snapshot deadline from five-second Docker metadata and unchanged project test deadlines; no implicit unknown-effect retry.

Report the exact source identity mismatch metadata without file contents; retain strict fail-closed checks. A separate explicit source-review reuse opt-in recognizes only the exact qualified diagnostics-only runner patch by whole-file byte comparison and preserves both runner identities and all unchanged review-visible contract and request bytes.

Legacy defaults and all old grants remain strict.

New explicitly ordinal-bound fourth repair; retained failed container diagnostics are independently receipt/candidate/runner/source-reference checked, bounded stack locations and new source context remain untrusted. Preserve all old grants and charges; reconcile diagnostic review payment against its own descendant budget while the new repair uses an existing ancestor allocation. Publication checks four Git links; no arbitrary repair loop.
